feature.title: Support playing bags with topics in mixed serialization formats.
feature.author: clalancette

hidden_tests_patch.note: PR test-side hunks (6 test .cpp/.hpp files, one test link line in rosbag2_transport/CMakeLists.txt). changes.patch + hidden_tests.patch applied at the base commit reproduce the merge commit tree exactly (tree c9ad4f921b97d598587b013246c4bae065f764a5).

feature.generative_ai_disclosed_by_author: PR body: 'Did you use Generative AI? Yes, Claude Opus 5'

oracle.reference: sqlite3 vs mcap storage plugins of the same rosbag2 tree (tests/differential/mixed_formats_differential.cpp) and `ros2 bag play` outcomes for both (tests/cli_play_check.py); plus the PR's own gtests and pristine regression suites with exact counts (tests/expected_counts.json)
oracle.reference_binaries_in_agent_image: none; rosbag2 debs are purged, the overlay is the only rosbag2

contamination.notes: Merged 2026-09-11, two days before construction; rolling debs in the image (0.34.0, built 2026-08-21) predate the PR. PR body discloses the author used Claude Opus 5; the task tests behaviour and cross-plugin parity, not the reference text.

horizon.proxy: 16 non-test files across 6 packages (storage struct, both storage plugins, reader open/read paths, compression reader/writer, converter, readers manager, player), 338 non-test additions; interacting requirements: per-message tagging with plugin/metadata fallback, three-way open semantics, undeliverable-topic bookkeeping across readers, player resolution ordering and three filter kinds, byte-exact pass-through, parity across two storage backends; each build cycle of the touched packages is 30-45 min

evidence: https://github.com/ros2/rosbag2/pull/2476 (user-facing: 'after this change users should be able to open mcap/bag files that have multiple encodings in them')

rosbag2_cpp/readers/sequential_reader.cpp at base: check_topics_serialization_formats() throws 'Topics with different rmw serialization format have been found. All topics must have the same serialization format.'

read_next_fills_in_serialization_format_from_metadata: storage leaves format empty, reader sets it to topic's format
read_next_keeps_serialization_format_set_by_storage

reads_mixed_serialization_formats_from_real_bag (mcap): raw read tags each message with its topic's format; open with rmw format lists protobuf topic undeliverable, first message cdr, second read throws; filtered read yields 5; open with some_other_format throws

derivability.assertion: RosBag2PlayTestFixture.topics_with_unplayable_serialization_format_can_be_filtered_out: default play publishes topic1's 2 messages; --topics topic2 makes Player constructor throw; --exclude-topics topic2 plays; --topics topic1 plays; all-undeliverable bag makes constructor throw

test_rewrite_bag_with_mixed_serialization_formats: rewrite of mixed mcap bag preserves both topics' formats, protobuf bytes byte-identical, counts 5/5; filtered output contains only /chatter with 5 messages
Differential harness: sqlite3 and mcap dumps identical for raw, requested_rmw, requested_unknown, uniform, only_proto, message/file-compressed scenarios

Differential harness: compressed bags (zstd MESSAGE and FILE mode) read back with the same tagged formats and bytes as the uncompressed bag; compressed + requested rmw + filter yields the 5 /chatter messages
derivability.instruction_ref: C1 (compression writer keeps format; decompressed messages tagged), C3

derivability.assertion: Differential harness: only_proto bag opened with rmw format throws at open (no protobuf converter plugin)
derivability.instruction_ref: C4 (uniform case, plugin missing; environment note)

derivability.assertion: CLI: `ros2 bag play mixed --topics /camera/video_compressed` exits non-zero and output names the topic; `ros2 bag play mixed --exclude-topics /chatter` (the protobuf topic is the only implicitly selected one) exits non-zero and names the topic; `ros2 bag play only_proto` exits non-zero with nothing received (reader open() fails on the missing protobuf converter, so the topic name is not required in the output)
derivability.instruction_ref: C6 bullets 1 and 3; C4 (uniform bag, converter plugin missing)

derivability.assertion: CLI: `ros2 bag play mixed` exits zero, output names the excluded topic, subscriber receives int32 values 0..4 on /chatter
CLI: `--exclude-topics /camera/video_compressed` and `--topics /chatter` exit zero, do not mention the topic, deliver 0..4; uniform bag plays 0..4
Pristine regression suites (multifile reader, converter factory, storage without metadata, sequential writer, both topic filters, compression reader/writer, readers manager) pass with exact counts
